name: NGC 5946 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 5946, a globular cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc5946-hubble
story: NGC 5946 is a tightly packed, metal-poor globular cluster whose core has collapsed. Hubble mapped how its light crowds toward the center, searching for hints of a hidden black hole.

claims.text: NGC 5946 is a core-collapsed globular cluster
HST program 11628 measured surface brightness profiles of highly concentrated globular clusters to find candidates for central black holes; NGC 5946 is a target
